decision: Preserve the Worker API and move app execution and storage to CellD on Verda
why: Avoid rewriting the review logic and keep the existing public URL through a stateless gateway

decision: Use a private Verda S3 bucket after passing the conditional-write and range probes
why: CellD relies on conditional writes and consistent reads for ownership and durability
result: single CAS winner and stale-write rejection verified

decision: Kill the process only after confirming an active review
why: The first restart preserved a completed review but did not exercise interrupted-task recovery
result: active review resumed and completed; one recovered ledger record

decision: Give review agents a separate unrestricted ephemeral Podman executor
why: The team explicitly chose a free shell and pinned checkout because formal verification cannot be meaningful without executing tools and inspecting a real worktree
result: local image builds; service and reviewer tools are covered by tests, not deployed
